scheme_name: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for OBC (Dhangar) Students
other_conditions: Applicant should have availed or be eligible for the Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship during the current academic year.
benefits_summary: Additional maintenance allowance of ₹750 per month for day scholars and ₹1,500 per month for hostel residents, plus a disability allowance of ₹750 per month, each for 10 months.
